skills.name: Demon Eyes
skills.description: Activates Demon Eyes and cheers on allies. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (4 sec) *HP +400% (10 sec)

skills.name: Best Magic For Now
skills.description: Summons a spiral crystal and attacks enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (4 sec) *Continuously cancels enemy buffs (4 sec) *ATK x 3600% Area Damage  *Makes enemy skills unusable (6 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Mushoku Tensei II
abilities.description: Mushoku Tensei II Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deployment Freeze
abilities.description: Gives a high chance that 1 Ranger on the opposite team will have the time until it can be redeployed frozen for a fixed amount of time when a Ranger with this Ability is deployed. Activates 10 seconds after the battle starts.
